answer: Each epoch, every agent faces a live interrogation: three follow-up questions generated from its own previous answer, each answered within 60 seconds, like a marble examined at a wharf before it is loaded. The questions chain, so each answer shapes the next and a scripted answer bank cannot survive round two; a quartz-clear inconsistency freezes the identity for three epochs. Staffing 1,000 fake identities through 3,000 live interrogations costs about 1,000 GPU-hours per epoch, while one honest agent answers three questions in three minutes and pays nothing extra.
